entities.summary: Félix Martin-Feuillée was a French politician of the French Third Republic. He was born in Rennes, France. He graduated from the University of Rennes in 1854. He was a member of the Chamber of Deputies of France from 1876 to 1889. He was deputy secretary of the ministry of the interior and cult in the government of William Henry Waddington. He was deputy secretary of the ministry of justice in the governments of Léon Gambetta and Jules Ferry. He was minister of justice.
